title: P-Video
description: Pruna AI P-Video — text-to-video; image-to-video with a start frame and an optional end frame; and audio-driven video from a supplied track. 720p or 1080p, 5 or 10 seconds, optional generated audio. Served by our direct Pruna integration.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Ignored when a start image already sets the frame.

audio.description: Optional driving-audio track (MP3/WAV/FLAC). Provide a public audio URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads (passed by URL, not inlined). When supplied, the video's length matches the audio and `length_seconds` is ignored — which changes the per-second charge, so estimate via POST /v1/cost.

end_image.description: Optional end frame, used together with `image` (the start frame) to interpolate the video between the two frames. Same input forms as `image`.

generate_audio.description: Keep the model's generated audio in the output (default true; no price impact).

image.description: Optional start frame for image-to-video. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-video.

length_seconds.description: Video length in seconds. Ignored when `audio` is supplied.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Omit for random.
